title: 2.9 Controlling Microorganisms
description: Physical, chemical and behavioural methods used to kill or inhibit microbes. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which term matches this description? The complete removal or killing of all microbial life
Which term matches this description? The process that kills pathogens on non-living surfaces
Which term matches this description? A chemical applied to living tissue to inhibit microbes
Which term matches this description? A compound produced by microbes that inhibits other microbes
Which term matches this description? An agent that kills or stops the growth of bacteria
Which term matches this description? An agent that kills or stops the growth of fungi
Which term matches this description? An agent that suppresses the replication of viruses
Which term matches this description? Using high temperatures to kill all microbial forms
Which term matches this description? A device that uses pressurised steam to sterilise materials
Which term matches this description? Heating liquids briefly to kill harmful microorganisms
Which term matches this description? Removing microbes by passing a liquid through a fine filter
Which term matches this description? Light used to damage microbial DNA and kill microbes
Which term matches this description? Removing water to stop microbial growth and survival
Which term matches this description? Slowing microbial growth by keeping food at low temperatures
Which term matches this description? Stopping microbial growth by turning water into ice
Which term matches this description? Drawing water out of microbes by making food salty
Which term matches this description? Using high sugar concentrations to inhibit microbial growth
Which term matches this description? A substance added to food to prevent microbial spoilage
Which term matches this description? Practices that prevent contamination by unwanted microbes
Which term matches this description? The ability of a microbe to withstand a control method
